name: Viridian City Gym & Giovanni Showdown
summary: The locked doors of Viridian Gym have finally opened. Solve the spin-arrow floor tile puzzle, defeat the 9 junior gym trainers, and confront Gym Leader Giovanni in a 5 vs 5 clash to earn the Earth Badge and TM26 Earthquake.

items.name: Earth Badge
items.method: Defeat Gym Leader Giovanni in the 5 vs 5 gym match

items.name: TM26 Earthquake
items.method: Gift from Giovanni upon earning the Earth Badge

items.name: Revive
items.method: Hidden in the northwest corner beyond the spin-arrow tracks
